```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Get AMZN price from Alpha Vantage
amzn_price=$(curl -s "https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=GLOBAL quotations&symbol=AMZN&apikey=YOUR_API_KEY" | jq -r '.Global quotations[0].Price')

# Calculate cost for 5 shares
total_usd=$(echo "$amzn_price * 5" | bc)

# Convert USD to EUR
usd_amount=$(echo "scale=2; $total_usd" | bc)
eur_amount=$(curl -s "https://api.exchangerate-api.com/v4/latest/USD?apikey=YOUR_API_KEY" | jq -r '.rates.EUR' | tr -d '"')
total_eur=$(echo "$usd_amount * $eur_amount" | bc)

# Send email using mailutils
echo "Amazon quote: €$total_eur" | mail -s 'Quote AMZN' finance@example.com
```
